nodes.summary: Let $\alpha$ be a compact topological space with its Borel $\sigma$-algebra, let $\mu$ be a measure on $\alpha$ that is positive on every nonempty open set, let $E$ be a seminormed additive commutative group, and let $f : \alpha \to E$ be continuous. Then the essential supremum of $\|f\|$ with respect to $\mu$ equals the supremum norm $\sup_{x \in \alpha} \|f(x)\|$ of $f$, as an equality in $[0, \infty]$.
nodes.title: Essential supremum of a continuous map

nodes.summary: Let $\alpha$ be a compact topological space with its Borel $\sigma$-algebra, let $\mu$ be a measure on $\alpha$ that is positive on every nonempty open set, let $E$ be a seminormed additive commutative group such that $\alpha$ or $E$ is second-countable, and let $f : \alpha \to E$ be continuous. Then $\|f\|_{L^\infty(\mu)} = \sup_{x \in \alpha} \|f(x)\|$, as an equality in $[0, \infty]$.
nodes.title: The $L^\infty$ norm of a continuous map is its supremum norm

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a real number, write $M^+ = \max(M, 0)$, and let $f_0, f_1, f_2, \dots : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ be functions that are almost everywhere strongly measurable with respect to Lebesgue measure restricted to $[0,1]$. If $\|f_n\|_{L^p[0,1]} \le M^+$ for every $n$ and every real $p \ge 1$, then $\|f_n\|_{L^\infty[0,1]} \le M^+$ for every $n$. All norms are taken with respect to Lebesgue measure restricted…
nodes.title: Uniform $L^p$ bounds on $(0,1)$ give the same $L^\infty$ bound

nodes.summary: Let $\mu$ be a finite measure on a measurable space $\alpha$ and let $f \colon \alpha \to \mathbb{R}$ be essentially bounded, $f \in L^\infty(\mu)$. Then $\|f\|_{L^p(\mu)} \to \|f\|_{L^\infty(\mu)}$ as the real exponent $p$ tends to $\infty$.
nodes.title: The $L^p$ norm tends to the $L^\infty$ norm

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
